boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented University of Evansville study environments, from computer-equipped commons to reservable library rooms and quiet window-side tables.

cards.title: Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Bower-Suhrheinrich Library, first floor
cards.notes: Set up at a computer workstation or study table, then use a movable whiteboard for planning. Collaborative spaces and comfortable seating are also available.
cards.short_summary: A flexible first-floor workspace with computers, whiteboards, tables, and collaborative areas.
cards.evidence_claim: UE lists 16 computer workstations, six collaborative spaces, study tables, moveable whiteboards, comfortable seating, and vending machines in the Information Commons.
cards.access_notes: Located on the library's first floor; check the library's current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Library Room 204
cards.subtitle: Bower-Suhrheinrich Library, second floor
cards.notes: Reserve this second-floor group room through Booked! when your work benefits from a TV and DVD player. UE students may reserve rooms for up to two hours daily.
cards.short_summary: A reservable group-study room with a TV and DVD player.
cards.evidence_claim: UE identifies Room 204 as a second-floor group study room with a TV and DVD player; group rooms are reservable by UE students for a daily maximum of two hours.
cards.access_notes: UE students reserve through Booked!; first-time users need to create an account, and reservations are limited to two hours daily.

cards.title: Library Room 206
cards.subtitle: Bower-Suhrheinrich Library, second floor
cards.notes: Book this documented conference-style room for shared media or discussion work. Confirm the reservation in Booked! before heading upstairs.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor group room documented with a TV and DVD player.
cards.evidence_claim: UE identifies Room 206 as a second-floor group study room with a TV and DVD player; the library's floor tour includes a Room 206 photo.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the library's Booked! system; group-room reservations are for UE students and limited to two hours daily.

cards.title: Second-Floor Library Study Tables
cards.subtitle: Bower-Suhrheinrich Library, second floor
cards.notes: Use the second-floor tables when you want nearby DVD and technical-services collections. Bring a partner if a movable whiteboard would help your session.
cards.short_summary: Table seating on a floor with DVD holdings, whiteboards, and group rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UE says the second floor has comfortable seating, study tables, moveable whiteboards, and three group study rooms, and houses the DVD collection.
cards.access_notes: Located on the library's second floor; check current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Third-Floor Window Study Tables
cards.subtitle: Bower-Suhrheinrich Library, third floor
cards.notes: Choose a table near the windows for independent reading or writing. Keep the session low-key: the university designates the third floor as a quiet space.
cards.short_summary: Quiet, window-side library tables near the A–H collection and CDs.
cards.evidence_claim: UE states that comfortable seating and study tables are near the third-floor windows and that the third floor is a quiet space.
cards.access_notes: Located on the library's third floor; observe the designated quiet-space setting and check current library hours.

cards.title: Library Room 401
cards.subtitle: Bower-Suhrheinrich Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Reserve Room 401 for a focused group session, then use the nearby fourth-floor tables for follow-up reading. Submit the booking before arriving.
cards.short_summary: One of the fourth floor's named, reservable group-study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UE's fourth-floor library tour identifies Library Room 401 and says 13 group study rooms near the windows can be reserved.
cards.access_notes: Reserve via the library's Booked! scheduler; group-room reservations are available to UE students for up to two hours daily.

cards.title: Library Room 403
cards.subtitle: Bower-Suhrheinrich Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Use the library scheduler to reserve Room 403 before meeting classmates. The fourth floor also keeps study tables close to the J–Z and oversize collections.
cards.short_summary: A named fourth-floor room beside library collections and study tables.
cards.evidence_claim: UE's fourth-floor library tour identifies Library Room 403 and says 13 group study rooms, study tables, and comfortable seating are on the floor.
cards.access_notes: Reserve via the library's Booked! scheduler; group-room reservations are available to UE students for up to two hours daily.

cards.title: Library Room 405
cards.subtitle: Bower-Suhrheinrich Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Plan a small-group work block in Room 405 and reserve it in advance. Keep your research materials handy with the J–Z stacks on the same floor.
cards.short_summary: A reservable named room on the fourth-floor study corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: UE's fourth-floor library tour identifies Library Room 405 and states that 13 group study rooms near the windows are reservable.
cards.access_notes: Reserve via the library's Booked! scheduler; group-room reservations are available to UE students for up to two hours daily.

cards.title: Library Room 407
cards.subtitle: Bower-Suhrheinrich Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Reserve Room 407 for a collaborative work session, then transition to nearby seating if you need to read independently. Verify your booking first.
cards.short_summary: A documented fourth-floor group-study room near window-side seating.
cards.evidence_claim: UE's fourth-floor library tour identifies Library Room 407 and says the floor has 13 reservable group study rooms near the windows.
cards.access_notes: Reserve via the library's Booked! scheduler; group-room reservations are available to UE students for up to two hours daily.

cards.entity_name: Earl M. and Ruby J. Tapley Education Resource and Multimedia Center
cards.title: Tapley Education Resource and Multimedia Center
cards.subtitle: William Graves Hall, Room 329
cards.notes: Head to Room 329 for table-based group work, printing, or hands-on project preparation. Check conditions first because staffing availability can affect hours.
cards.short_summary: An education resource center with computers, printing, digital equipment, and group-work tables.
cards.evidence_claim: UE says the Tapley Center offers two computer stations with PaperCut printing, digital equipment, ample table space for group work or meetings, and student-use materials.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–8 p.m. and Friday 8 a.m.–4 p.m., but UE notes hours may vary with work-study and supervisor availability.
